ciscoMemoryPoolTable.name: ciscoMemoryPoolTable
ciscoMemoryPoolTable.description: A table of memory pool monitoring entries.

ciscoMemoryPoolEntry.name: ciscoMemoryPoolEntry
ciscoMemoryPoolEntry.description: An entry containing information about a particular memory pool.

ciscoMemoryPoolType.name: ciscoMemoryPoolType
ciscoMemoryPoolType.description: The type of memory pool (e.g., 1 for Processor, 2 for I/O).

ciscoMemoryPoolName.name: ciscoMemoryPoolName
ciscoMemoryPoolName.description: A textual description of the memory pool.

ciscoMemoryPoolValid.name: ciscoMemoryPoolValid
ciscoMemoryPoolValid.description: Indicates whether the memory pool entry is valid.

ciscoMemoryPoolUsed.name: ciscoMemoryPoolUsed
ciscoMemoryPoolUsed.description: Indicates the number of bytes from the pool that are currently in use by the operating system.

ciscoMemoryPoolFree.name: ciscoMemoryPoolFree
ciscoMemoryPoolFree.description: Indicates the number of bytes from the pool that are currently free on the operating system.

ciscoMemoryPoolLargestFree.name: ciscoMemoryPoolLargestFree
ciscoMemoryPoolLargestFree.description: Indicates the largest contiguous block of free memory in bytes.

ciscoMemoryPoolAlternative.name: ciscoMemoryPoolAlternative
ciscoMemoryPoolAlternative.description: Identifies an alternate memory pool if this one runs out.
